references.text: Psalm 112:5 - Blessed is the one who is generous and lends, who conducts their affairs with justice.
Proverbs 11:25 - The one who blesses others will be richly blessed, and the one who helps others will be helped themselves.
Luke 19:13-26 - The parable of the minas, where servants are given different amounts of money to manage and are rewarded based on how they handle them.
Matthew 25:14-30 - The parable of the talents, which directly addresses the distribution of varying resources to servants and the expectation that they will manage them well.
